question: At a fixed 250 ms X11 hold deadline, does placing capture + PNG encode/write/fsync + PNG reopen/load before KeyRelease extend application-observed hold into a tens-of-ms regime compared with releasing before the same retained-artifact pipeline?
fixture: Xvfb 1024x768x24 + Openbox + rendered Tk checkerboard + XTEST w key
pipeline: full-frame Pillow ImageGrab -> PNG save -> fsync -> Image.open/load/getpixel

conditions.release_first: at deadline send KeyRelease+sync, then execute the retained-artifact pipeline
conditions.pipeline_first: at deadline execute the identical retained-artifact pipeline, then send KeyRelease+sync

primary_metric: paired pipeline_first-minus-release_first application-observed press-to-release duration in ms

decision.retained_artifact_boundary_cost_candidat: median paired delta >= 10 ms OR p95 paired delta >= 20 ms
decision.reject_as_tens_ms_explanation: median paired delta < 10 ms AND p95 paired delta < 20 ms

construction_smoke: 2 pairs only, excluded from formal aggregation; observed median paired delta 19.7639015 ms
scope: development mechanism isolation only; no ViZDoom, gameplay efficacy, model, planner, renewal, or shared-runtime claim
